articles.title: GTA 6 leaker cashes out of his own memecoin hours before Rockstar's gameplay reveal
articles.snippet: The token hit a $25 million market cap on the back of nine days of unreleased Grand Theft Auto VI footage. Its creator has now sold his stack — hours before Rockstar's first official gameplay reveal.

articles.title: California Senate passes bill to ban memecoin issuance by public officials
articles.snippet: The bill seeks to prohibit the listing of memecoins issued by federal public officials to California residents, citing conflicts of interest and “pay-to-play arrangements.”

articles.title: Trump cost investors $4.7B through crypto ‘schemes’: Public Citizen
articles.snippet: While investors in World Liberty Financial‘s USD1 stablecoin “haven’t suffered major losses,” many lost billions of dollars in other Trump ventures, according to Public Citizen.

articles.title: Grayscale says Zcash can challenge Bitcoin’s network effects as privacy demand grows
articles.snippet: ZEC has climbed roughly 19-fold in a year, yet Grayscale says its sub-1% share of Bitcoin’s market cap leaves room for further upside.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Solana Jumps with Network Inflation Set to Drop
articles.snippet: Two majors proposals are set to pass, its leading DATs are back, and Schwab is offering SOL to its clients—quite the setup for Solana.
